sloka: स त्वम् ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्या प्रतिश्रवः ।न त्वाम् रामो विजानीते सर्पम् मण्डूक राविणम् ॥४-३४-१५॥
transliteration: sa tvam grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu sakto mithyā pratiśravaḥ ।na tvām rāmo vijānīte sarpam maṇḍūka rāviṇam ॥4-34-15॥

translations.english: 'You have failed to keep your word. You are engaged in worldly pleasures. Rama did not know that you are a serpent croaking like a frog.
